title: PPO net2 on net1 v5 with the team reward and a value network that counts the other flows, three seeds
description: The second arm next to exp-net2-ppo-team: the same training (team reward for copies, tau = 1 s, sigma = 0.05, K = 4, the competition mix with 2 or 4 copies, learning rate 3e-4 or 1e-3, seeds 1, 2 and 3, 60 iterations), and the value network also sees, at each decision, how many other copies of the policy, stock TCP flows and UDP flows share the link then (critic_flows). That is privileged, like the true LCFs it already sees, and never reaches the actor; a value function that knows whether the flow faces its copies or a buffer-filling competitor should give the actor advantages with less noise in the states where the two must be told apart. The policies go to the same gate (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py, campaign seed 21). Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-flows-lr$LR-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .lr = $lr | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-flows-lr$LR-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
